structure.unit: Local Constitutional Officers, Courthouses and Supplies

law.catch_line: Part-time compensated assistants to attorneys for the Commonwealth
law.text: Notwithstanding any contrary provisions of §§ 15.2-1627.1, 15.2-1628 and 15.2-1630, the Compensation Board at the request of the attorney for the Commonwealth may provide for one compensated part-time assistant to a full-time attorney for the Commonwealth.
